nodes.rationale: Maps each AMPM decision to the screens it changes: Q1 native iOS/Android apps (all CP and TW screens become app screens, offline indicators extend to TW-70 and TW-56); Q13 mobile OTP (new AUTH-06, AUTH-01 staff only); Q3 demo limits and street view; Q2 basic wedding details before payment, card or UPI only; Q5 two equal family representatives; Q7 read-only guest summaries for clients, no guest editing after submission; Q20 live chat (CP-42, TW-98); Q4 no online milestone payments at launch; Q12 TW-97 dropped; Q10 only Super Admin authorises exceptions; Q9 indicative rate ranges, menus grid, street view; Q8/Q17 no automatic deletion, retention proposals in TW-95; Q23 three-month access window and archive on approval.

nodes.label: CP-41 Closed project state
nodes.rationale: Banner making the read-only period explicit until client_access_until (A-23); requests limited to support; no edits, decisions or uploads. After Q23 names three months.

nodes.label: T8 Live console template
nodes.rationale: Full-width, high-contrast, large touch targets, current-time indicator, sync status, minimal chrome; for run-of-show live view, event-day console and readiness board.

nodes.label: TW-45 Closure checklist and final accounts
nodes.norm_label: tw-45 closure checklist and final accounts
nodes.rationale: Closes a wedding with evidence (SPEC 7, 12): each checklist item has a live data check; Close is enabled only when complete or complete with an authorised exception and final accounts approved. After Q10 Authorise exception is Super Admin only; after Q23 Archive is a Super Admin approval after the access window.

nodes.label: TW-56 Travel and transport
nodes.rationale: Travel segments, vehicles (driver phone RESTRICTED-CONTACT), transfers with seat validation, manifests exported without identity data; arrival lists offline-capable after Q1.

nodes.label: TW-70 Tasks
nodes.rationale: Accountability for everything (SPEC 3); blocked needs a reason; offline-capable after Q1.

nodes.label: TW-72 Staffing roster
nodes.rationale: Who is on site, when, in which role (GP-30); overlap warnings; publishing notifies.

nodes.label: TW-73 Run-of-show editor and live view
nodes.norm_label: tw-73 run-of-show editor and live view
nodes.rationale: Internal cue sheet and its execution; never client-visible; offline the cached cues stay readable, actions queue and a banner counts queued updates (T-11, U-7).

nodes.label: TW-74 Readiness board
nodes.rationale: Required checks per function with a go-live gate explaining what blocks; readiness cannot complete without checks or an authorised exception (SPEC 7, 12, P-8). After Q10 Authorise exception is Super Admin only; the Project Manager sees Request exception.

nodes.label: TW-75 Incidents
nodes.rationale: Report, assign, escalate and resolve; critical unassigned incidents past the configured minutes escalate automatically; client-visible toggle off by default.

nodes.label: TW-76 Event-day console
nodes.rationale: One screen for the wedding day: functions with readiness and live status, current cues, arrivals and transfers in the next hour, incidents, staff on duty, sync indicator (T-11, T-14).

nodes.label: Team workspace area: Tasks and Operations (TW-7x)
nodes.norm_label: team workspace area: tasks and operations (tw-7x)

nodes.label: Offline capability and sync indicator (W-10)
nodes.rationale: Live-operations screens cache data, queue actions when offline and show a sync indicator with the count of queued updates. AMPM's Q1 decision moved offline support to launch and extended it to tasks, department information and arrival lists.

nodes.label: W-10 Live-operations screens offline-capable with a sync indicator
nodes.norm_label: w-10 live-operations screens offline-capable with a sync indicator
nodes.rationale: Audit GP-34, T-11. Originally Phase 4 for TW-73, TW-74, TW-76. AMPM 2026-10-25: changed; offline screens at launch and extended to tasks, department information and arrival lists.

nodes.label: Runbooks (rebuild, restore, deploy, rotate, incident, upgrade)
nodes.norm_label: runbooks (rebuild, restore, deploy, rotate, incident, upgrade)

nodes.label: VPS security baseline
nodes.rationale: SSH key-only no root, ufw default deny (22/80/443), fail2ban, non-root pinned containers, internal-only PG/Redis, full-disk and repo encryption, identity bucket own KMS key, yearly secret rotation, pen test before launch.

nodes.label: K1: Hours and months
nodes.rationale: Locked: 40 hours a week as the planning baseline; one person's pace is the single biggest schedule driver.

nodes.label: K20: Commercial arrangement
nodes.rationale: Locked: time and materials; infrastructure alone ~US$450-900/mo before WhatsApp, SMS, gateway and video fees.

nodes.label: K21: Provider account ownership
nodes.rationale: Cloud, gateway, WhatsApp, SMS DLT, Apple, Google, video and monitoring accounts need AMPM's company documents and take weeks; the plan's first week is account opening.

nodes.label: Developer Risk Questions (K1-K22)
nodes.rationale: 22 developer questions feeding the milestone schedule and cost estimate; locked 26 Oct: K1 40h/week baseline, K20 time-and-materials, K10 dedicated VPS, Cognito identity, code in this repo.

nodes.label: Delivery model D-012 (one developer + Claude Code)
nodes.norm_label: delivery model d-012 (one developer + claude code)
nodes.rationale: Recorded 26 Oct 2026: one developer builds the whole platform with Claude Code, no other developers, designers or testers; the delivery model the risk questions test.

nodes.label: Deployment freeze while any project is live
nodes.norm_label: deployment freeze while any project is live
nodes.rationale: Hotfixes only, with the project lead informed (T-14).

nodes.label: Retention jobs propose deletions; Super Admin approves
nodes.norm_label: retention jobs propose deletions; super admin approves
nodes.rationale: AMPM decided (Q8, Q17) there is no automatic deletion; nothing is deleted until SA approves.

nodes.label: Status transitions and who may make them (§7)
nodes.norm_label: status transitions and who may make them (§7)

nodes.label: Automation performed by the system principal (§8)
nodes.norm_label: automation performed by the system principal (§8)
nodes.rationale: Every system change is still written to audit_events with actor_type = system.

nodes.norm_label: user-flow changes from ampm decisions of 25 october 2026

nodes.norm_label: coverage of spec §14 flows and the level-1 flowcharts

nodes.norm_label: flow 12 — entitlement changes: expiry, suspension, closure window

nodes.norm_label: flow 5 — versioned creative approvals (designs, menus, invitations)

nodes.norm_label: open questions raised by the flows

nodes.label: Parallel planning streams (BIZ rule 3)
nodes.rationale: Once a project exists, flows 4 to 8 run concurrently and independently.

nodes.label: T-14 On-call cover on wedding days and deployment freeze while live
nodes.norm_label: t-14 on-call cover on wedding days and deployment freeze while live

nodes.label: U-10 Notifications by preferred channel with WhatsApp opt-in
nodes.norm_label: u-10 notifications by preferred channel with whatsapp opt-in

nodes.label: U-12 Questions as tracked requests plus live chat
nodes.norm_label: u-12 questions as tracked requests plus live chat
nodes.rationale: Originally no free-form chat; AMPM added live chat alongside tracked requests, so a chat message can be turned into a tracked request that follows Flow 6.

nodes.label: U-2 Subscription purchased inside the portal
nodes.norm_label: u-2 subscription purchased inside the portal
nodes.rationale: Account created by AMPM; the client completes basic wedding details then pays online only by card or UPI; anonymous checkout would contradict WHY §4.

nodes.label: U-3 Availability check included, other hotel services chargeable
nodes.norm_label: u-3 availability check included, other hotel services chargeable
nodes.rationale: Availability checks are part of the subscription; negotiation, site visits, contract review and booking assistance need an accepted service agreement; fees for those not yet decided.

nodes.label: U-5 Guest list, per-side links and locked submissions
nodes.norm_label: u-5 guest list, per-side links and locked submissions
nodes.rationale: Links per side or combined; guests identify their household; no editing after submission; corrections through the RSVP team; reminders then calls, with assisted entry writing the same rows.

nodes.label: U-6 Project created on accepted broader-services agreement
nodes.norm_label: u-6 project created on accepted broader-services agreement
nodes.rationale: Project creation back-fills saved hotels, enquiries and agreements; AMPM records the agreement and creates the project.

nodes.label: U-8 Closure feedback, three-month read-only window, archive on approval
nodes.norm_label: u-8 closure feedback, three-month read-only window, archive on approval

nodes.label: CP-11 Subscription, plans and agreements
nodes.rationale: Buy or renew the subscription, accept service agreements and pay milestones. Prices and terms come from plans and service_agreements, never from code; no purchase before AMPM has activated the account (WHY 4). After Q2 a first step Your wedding collects couple's names, contact, tentative dates and preferred locations, and the client-side bank-transfer path is removed (card or UPI only).

nodes.label: PUB-01 Home
nodes.rationale: Positions AMPM and the three service stages and converts visitors to enquiries or demo requests (SPEC 2.1). No hotel names, prices or private data (BIZ 2.A); only media with public rights (GP-20); showcase carousel and destination grid are omitted when nothing is published.

nodes.label: PUB-02 How it works
nodes.rationale: Explains hotel discovery, optional consultancy and complete management as separate stages (SPEC 2.1 critical rule). No prices in code; fee copy comes from the CMS and is approved by AMPM (BIZ rule 8).

nodes.label: PUB-04 Destinations and selected work
nodes.rationale: Builds confidence with approved public examples without exposing the private database: hotels flagged public_showcase show name and hero image only; no rates, rooms, venues, contacts or verification data and no hotel detail page on the public site (GP-20).

nodes.label: PUB-06 Contact, enquiry and demo request
nodes.norm_label: pub-06 contact, enquiry and demo request
nodes.rationale: Captures a lead with source, consent and context. Email or phone required, not both; duplicates are accepted and flagged to Sales for merging, never refused to the visitor; no account is created here (WHY 4); consent_marketing unchecked by default; low-friction bot check.

nodes.label: PUB-07 Demo and subscription
nodes.rationale: Explains demo access, plan inclusions, fee and terms and collects a request only; purchase happens in CP-11 after AMPM activates the account (W-15, U-2). Prices come from the plans table, never from code (SPEC 10).

nodes.label: PUB-09 Enquiry submitted
nodes.rationale: Shows no data the visitor entered beyond their first name.

nodes.label: Public website (PUB screens, Phase 1)
nodes.rationale: Top navigation Home, How it works, Destinations, Services, About, Contact with a persistent Request a demo call to action. No sign-in link in the main navigation, only a small Client sign-in in footer and header utility area, so the website does not read as an app (WHY section 1). Pages are static renders from CMS content tables (W-4), though AMPM dropped the website editor.

nodes.label: TW-92 Plans and packages
nodes.rationale: Configurable commercial plans, modules, demo plan, terms version (SPEC 10, A-3).

nodes.label: W-15 Plan selection and payment happen on CP-11 after activation; PUB-07 collects a request only
nodes.norm_label: w-15 plan selection and payment happen on cp-11 after activation; pub-07 collects a request only
nodes.rationale: Audit Q2, Q3, U-2. Anonymous checkout contradicts WHY section 4. AMPM 2026-10-25: confirmed; purchase after activation with the basic wedding details form first.

nodes.label: W-4 Public pages rendered statically from CMS content tables, edited in TW-97
nodes.norm_label: w-4 public pages rendered statically from cms content tables, edited in tw-97
nodes.rationale: Audit Q12, A-12. AMPM 2026-10-25: dropped, no website editor; TW-97 is not built.

nodes.label: A-15 - ~200 hotels, 20 concurrent weddings; capacity TBC
nodes.norm_label: a-15 - ~200 hotels, 20 concurrent weddings; capacity tbc
nodes.rationale: Status: changed. About 200 hotels and 20 concurrent weddings; staff and guest capacity to be confirmed.

nodes.label: A-27 - (not addressed; stands)
nodes.rationale: Status: stands. Not addressed; stands.

nodes.label: A-9 - indicative hotel pricing ranges, menu grids, ~200 hotels
nodes.norm_label: a-9 - indicative hotel pricing ranges, menu grids, ~200 hotels
nodes.rationale: Status: confirmed. Confirmed and extended: prices are indicative ranges including wedding package ranges and per-plate pricing, menu grids, street view; Eva updates about three times a year; about 200 hotels at the start.

nodes.label: T-7 - sized for 200 hotels/20 weddings; monolith fits
nodes.norm_label: t-7 - sized for 200 hotels/20 weddings; monolith fits
nodes.rationale: Status: changed. Sized for about 200 hotels and 20 concurrent weddings; the monolith still fits.

nodes.label: V-5 - load profiles rescaled to 200 hotels/20 weddings
nodes.norm_label: v-5 - load profiles rescaled to 200 hotels/20 weddings
nodes.rationale: Status: changed. Load profiles rescaled to 200 hotels and 20 weddings; staff and guest numbers to be confirmed.

nodes.label: Confirm 7 - initial capacity for staff, hotels, weddings, guests
nodes.norm_label: confirm 7 - initial capacity for staff, hotels, weddings, guests
nodes.rationale: Initial capacity for staff, hotels, weddings and guests. Status: open, to be confirmed by AMPM.

nodes.label: Q15 - scale: hotels, concurrent weddings & capacity
nodes.norm_label: q15 - scale: hotels, concurrent weddings & capacity
nodes.rationale: Status: partly. Decision: About 200 hotels at the start and roughly 20 concurrent weddings as a planning assumption; multiple weddings and departmental staff access; staff and guest capacity to be confirmed. Open: Staff count and largest guest count.

nodes.label: Q9 - hotel data, pages & indicative pricing
nodes.norm_label: q9 - hotel data, pages & indicative pricing
nodes.rationale: Status: decided. Decision: Eva maintains the existing hotel data and updates seasonal prices roughly three times a year. Hotel pages show hotel and venue details, rooms, photographs and videos, food and menu information in a grid, approximate room pricing, wedding package price ranges, indicative venue rental, approximate per-plate pricing, capacity and facilities, and street view or map location. Prices are indicative ranges with a last-verified date, never internal cost. Availability is checked by the team when a client requests it or adds a hotel to their selection. Previous clients' photographs appear only with permission, controlled by AMPM. Hotels can be imported from spreadsheets. About 200 hotels at the start.

nodes.label: Requirement 3 - hotel page content & information states
nodes.norm_label: requirement 3 - hotel page content & information states
nodes.rationale: Hotel page content: food and menu information in a grid, vegetarian and non-vegetarian menus, approximate per-plate pricing, wedding package price ranges, indicative venue rental, approximate room pricing, street view or map; the portal must distinguish indicative, requested, verified and awaiting-confirmation information.

nodes.label: Requirement 4 - selection/cart triggers availability request
nodes.rationale: Selection or cart: adding a hotel to the selection can trigger an availability request to the hotel team.

nodes.label: Added requirement: readiness exceptions record the unmet check, reason, authorised person, time and resulting status
nodes.norm_label: added requirement: readiness exceptions record the unmet check, reason, authorised person, time and resulting status
nodes.rationale: Only Eva's authorised personnel may approve a readiness exception.

nodes.label: Decision Q10: first release includes demo, discovery, wedding management, vendors, portal, department access, RSVP, requests, live chat and offline operations
nodes.norm_label: decision q10: first release includes demo, discovery, wedding management, vendors, portal, department access, rsvp, requests, live chat and offline operations
nodes.rationale: Excludes website editing, online milestone payments and GST invoicing; only Eva's authorised personnel may approve operational exceptions and the authority must be configurable.

nodes.label: Eva (AMPM; maintains the hotel data; her authorised personnel approve operational exceptions)
nodes.norm_label: eva (ampm; maintains the hotel data; her authorised personnel approve operational exceptions)

nodes.label: Open: single release or hotel discovery first with the wedding modules following
nodes.norm_label: open: single release or hotel discovery first with the wedding modules following

nodes.label: Principle: a function cannot go live with a required check unmet unless a named manager records an exception
nodes.norm_label: principle: a function cannot go live with a required check unmet unless a named manager records an exception
nodes.rationale: The specification's readiness rule; confirmed, only Eva's authorised personnel may record the exception.

nodes.label: Assumed Q10: demo and trial, full hotel assistance, online payment and website editing all in Phase 1
nodes.norm_label: assumed q10: demo and trial, full hotel assistance, online payment and website editing all in phase 1
nodes.rationale: Exceptions letting a function go live with a check unmet authorised by the Wedding Project Manager or the Super Admin; anything removed moves to a later phase and shortens Phase 1.

nodes.label: A-2 - online payment via Razorpay, no refund, manual fallback
nodes.norm_label: a-2 - online payment via razorpay, no refund, manual fallback
nodes.rationale: Status: changed. Online payment only, by card or UPI through Razorpay, after AMPM creates or invites the account and the client enters basic wedding details; no refund is offered; manual recording stays as a staff fallback. Decided_on: 2026-10-26.

nodes.label: T-3 - Razorpay hosted checkout, activate once, no refunds
nodes.norm_label: t-3 - razorpay hosted checkout, activate once, no refunds
nodes.rationale: Status: confirmed. Razorpay, card and UPI, hosted checkout, activation once per transaction; no refunds offered. Decided_on: 2026-10-26.

nodes.label: U-2 - wedding details before paying; online payment
nodes.norm_label: u-2 - wedding details before paying; online payment
nodes.rationale: Status: confirmed. Confirmed; the client also completes basic wedding details before paying; payment online only.

nodes.label: V-1 - Razorpay sandbox for contract tests
nodes.norm_label: v-1 - razorpay sandbox for contract tests
nodes.rationale: Status: confirmed. Razorpay sandbox for the contract tests. Decided_on: 2026-10-26.

nodes.label: W-15 - purchase after activation, details form first
nodes.norm_label: w-15 - purchase after activation, details form first
nodes.rationale: Status: confirmed. Purchase after activation, with the basic wedding details form first.

nodes.label: Confirm 3 - payment gateway & transaction handling
nodes.rationale: Payment gateway provider and transaction-handling requirements. Status: Answered 26 October 2026: Razorpay; transaction handling as in the brief's section 3; no refunds.

nodes.label: Q2 - account creation & online subscription payment (Razorpay)
nodes.norm_label: q2 - account creation & online subscription payment (razorpay)
nodes.rationale: Status: decided. Decision: AMPM creates the client's account or sends an invitation link. The client enters basic wedding details (couple's names, contact information, tentative dates, preferred locations) and pays the subscription online by card or UPI. The gateway provider will be selected by AMPM. Payments must create a record, activate the subscription once, and be reviewable by authorised staff. Decided 26 October 2026: Razorpay is the gateway.

nodes.label: Requirement 2 - account activation with wedding details before payment
nodes.norm_label: requirement 2 - account activation with wedding details before payment
nodes.rationale: Account activation: the client completes basic wedding details (couple's names, contact information, tentative dates, preferred locations) before paying.

nodes.label: R2 - payment gateway: Razorpay
nodes.rationale: Decided 2026-10-26, relayed by the developer, to be countersigned by AMPM in the blueprint sign-off sheet. Razorpay.

nodes.label: A-5 - two equal family-rep accounts, no viewer/finance role
nodes.norm_label: a-5 - two equal family-rep accounts, no viewer/finance role
nodes.rationale: Status: changed. Two family representatives, one per side, with equal rights; no viewer role and no finance flag; working decision two individually authenticated accounts, each verified by email and mobile, to be countersigned. Decided_on: 2026-10-26.

nodes.label: P-2 - two equal family reps replace owner/approver/viewer
nodes.norm_label: p-2 - two equal family reps replace owner/approver/viewer
nodes.rationale: Status: changed. Two family representatives with equal rights replace the owner, approver and viewer roles.

nodes.label: P-9 - on-behalf decisions with note/record
nodes.rationale: Status: confirmed. On-behalf decisions allowed with a note or supporting record.

nodes.label: U-4 - on-behalf decisions with note/record
nodes.rationale: Status: confirmed. On-behalf decisions with a note or record.

nodes.label: V-14 - on-behalf decision tests
nodes.rationale: Status: confirmed. On-behalf decision tests stand.

nodes.label: W-5 - no finance flag; portal finance display TBC
nodes.norm_label: w-5 - no finance flag; portal finance display tbc
nodes.rationale: Status: changed. No finance flag; the two representatives have equal rights; what finance the portal shows is to be confirmed.

nodes.label: Confirm 4 - family-rep login model
nodes.rationale: Whether the two family representatives share one login or have separate authenticated accounts. Status: Working decision 26 October 2026: two individually authenticated accounts, to be countersigned.

nodes.label: Q5 - client-portal family representatives & logins
nodes.rationale: Status: partly. Decision: Only two nominated family representatives use the client portal, one from the bride's side and one from the groom's side; the families decide who. No other family member may hold an account without AMPM's authorisation. Cost and margin information is never visible to them. AMPM may record a decision made outside the portal when a note or supporting record is attached. Confirmed 26 October 2026: the client-portal access and permission rules of the brief's section 5 stand as written. Working decision on logins: two individually authenticated accounts, the brief's stated preference, to be countersigned. Open: Login implementation: working decision of 26 October 2026 is two individually authenticated accounts; AMPM to countersign; Whether one representative's approval completes a decision or both must approve.

nodes.label: R5 - two individually authenticated family-rep accounts
nodes.norm_label: r5 - two individually authenticated family-rep accounts
nodes.rationale: Decided 2026-10-26, relayed by the developer, to be countersigned by AMPM in the blueprint sign-off sheet. Working decision: two individually authenticated accounts, the brief's stated preference; the brief's section 5 access and permission rules are confirmed as written. To be countersigned.
